bucket.available_help: GoRun reads these completely and imports them.
bucket.partial_help: Something is missing or hidden; the note says how to get the rest.
bucket.unavailable_help: These stay behind and must be rebuilt in GoRun (usually as theme components).
conflict.duplicate_in_source: Two WordPress items share this slug
conflict.existing: A GoRun item already uses this slug
connect.auth_help: Create one in WordPress under Users → Profile → Application Passwords. It unlocks raw blocks, authors' emails, menus and product meta. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
connect.intro: Read the site through its REST API, or upload an export file when the API hides what you need.
connect.name: Name (optional)
connect.rest_help: Only GET requests are made. Nothing on the WordPress site changes.
connect.title: Connect to WordPress
connect.wxr_help: In WordPress: Tools → Export → All content. Up to 200 MB. Exports include product meta (MCBB plans) and menus.
error.credentials_pair: Enter both the username and the application password, or neither.
error.field_key: Use lowercase letters, digits and _ (starting with a letter).
error.running: This migration is running; pause it first.
error.upload_invalid: This is not a WordPress export (WXR) file.
error.upload_size: The file is larger than 200 MB.
error.url: Enter a full http(s) address, e.g. https://example.com.
fields.empty: No custom fields were exposed by the site.
fields.intro: Meta keys seen in the samples. Give a field key to keep a value, leave it empty to skip.
fields.title: Map custom fields
import.intro: Runs in the background item by item. You can leave this page; pause and resume at any time.
import.title: Import
intro: Move a WordPress site into GoRun: scan, map, preview, import and validate.
list.empty: No migrations yet. Start one to bring a WordPress site over.
log.magic_link: Imported authors sign in with a magic link (their WordPress password is not migrated).
map.intro: Choose where each WordPress type goes. Products go to the shop catalog.
map.taxonomies_help: Terms are matched by slug. Product categories become shop groups automatically.
map.title: Map content types
preview.dry_help: Nothing is created: no content, media, terms, users, menus or redirects.
preview.intro: Runs the whole import without writing anything, and lists what would happen.
preview.needs_commerce: Products need the commerce module; they are skipped until it is installed.
preview.shortcodes: Shortcodes are left in place and listed in the validation report.
preview.title: Preview (dry run)
scan.auth_failed: WordPress rejected the username or application password. Nothing was scanned; check the credentials and try again.
scan.empty: No scan yet. Run one to see what can be migrated.
scan.intro: What GoRun can read from this site, sorted by what will move, what moves partly and what does not.
scan.sampled: sampled from the first 100 items per type
scan.title: Discovery report
scan.unreachable: The site could not be reached or does not look like WordPress.
title: WordPress migrations
validate.empty: No report yet. It is generated when the import finishes.
validate.intro: Counts, render checks, broken links, missing media, shortcodes and changed slugs.
validate.shortcodes_help: Rebuild these as theme components (e.g. plan and platform cards).
validate.title: Validation report
connect.rate_help: Limit for REST reads and media downloads from this site, 1 to 20. Empty: the wpmigrate.rate_per_second setting, else 4.
error.rate: Enter a number of requests per second from 1 to 20, or leave it empty
health.unavailable: Migration health could not be read
validate.unverified_help: These checks were unavailable or skipped. Generating the report does not confirm that these paths work.
check.reason.content_unavailable: Imported content could not be read
validate.summary_help: Validated means a report was generated. Errors and checks that were not verified prevent full readiness.
validate.readiness.ready: Ready within report scope: checks passed
validate.limitation.semantic_reconciliat: This report does not reconcile complete source text, relationships, authors, taxonomy or SEO with WordPress.
validate.limitation.legacy_report_checks: Checks in this legacy report are not fully recorded. Run validation again for current readiness.
check.reason.legacy_report_checks_not_re: Legacy validation checks were not recorded
preview.content_states_help: Only rows readable by the source account are planned. Draft, pending, scheduled and private content keeps its native visibility.
scan.auth_unavailable: WordPress denied the authenticated account profile. No public fallback was attempted; check this account’s REST permissions.
content_states.scan_title: Readable content by type and source state
content_states.scan_help: Counts cover rows readable by this account in the requested states. Unavailable types have unknown counts. Header bounds and exclusions are shown below.
content_states.preview_title: Selected content by type and source state
content_states.preview_help: Counts describe selected readable source rows, including planned skips. Planned actions above are separate; these are not transferred or validated totals.
